QF.id: IV Clearing Settlement and Risk Management_36

question.text: What is the minimum percentage of margin that must be maintained in cash or cash equivalents?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook requires that cash equivalents (the cash component) form at least 50% of the total collateral. The remaining 50% may be held in approved non-cash collateral, subject to specified haircuts and limits. The Trap: 25% understates the regulatory minimum; 75% and 100% overstate it. The 50% figure is the binding floor for the cash component, not the entire margin requirement. Note: Per pages 257, 259 and 268, the cash component / cash equivalents include cash, bank fixed deposit receipts (FDRs), bank guarantees and Central Government / Government of India securities. Approved equity / mutual fund units etc. fall outside the cash component.
